novel_mechanics_found: L7 helper-to-helper ballistics are directional and order-sensitive. A selected horizontal 6x3 helper, aligned immediately above the vertical 3x6 helper, launches the vertical helper 15 pixels downward through the otherwise solid lower partition. The inverse arrangement (selected vertical helper pushing the horizontal helper sideways) stayed blocked across exact and partial alignments, approach momentum, and every cycling-stack phase. The rectangular helpers also could not relocate the lower cycling stack from either side, unlike L6's selected square. Direct ACTION6 probes on the plus, cycling stack, color-15 partitions, and color-2 barriers were inert.
narrative: The resolver supplied a 358-action prefix, which I replayed once from a fresh reset and confirmed at frame.levels_completed == 6. With a two-layer-safe frame printer I then used 203 live L7 calls before the level timer expired: I transported and socketed the horizontal helper, transported the vertical helper through the central three-column passage, reproduced the helper-ram-through-partition mechanic, tested both ram directions and all six cycling-stack phases, and directly probed every unexplained major glyph class. No L7 win was observed. The rendered frame became empty on call 561; eight already-batched post-terminal calls brought the exact session total to 569. A fresh reproduction gate could not fit because the 358-call starting prefix alone exceeded the 131-call remainder, so no new level is claimed.
gotchas: The verified six-level prefix costs 358 env.step calls, so one mandatory confirmation leaves only 342 calls and makes a second full fresh-reset reproduction gate mathematically impossible under a 700-call cap.
ka59 frames may arrive as (2, 64, 64), (1, 64, 64), or multi-frame animation stacks; perception must consistently use the last layer and tolerate an empty (0,) payload after timeout.

The horizontal 6x3 helper can ram the vertical 3x6 helper through a solid barrier, but extensive inverse-direction tests did not move the horizontal helper. Plan helper order around this asymmetric verb.
A helper aligned above the lower cycling stack transports upward exactly when the stack wraps to all-d; harmless left-right oscillation while aligned can tune the six-step phase.
The lower cycling stack did not move when either rectangular helper pushed it from either side at all six phases; do not assume L6's square-driven stack relocation generalizes to L7.
ACTION5 is a true no-op on live L7 and does not reset the level. When the bottom timer reached zero, the next directional action returned an empty frame and subsequent actions stayed empty.
The required prefix confirmation was a direct fresh-reset replay through plan.apply_fn, not a reproduce() call; reproduction_verified is therefore false.
